general.accentNote: Buttons, selections and the glow around a folder you drop.
general.motionNote: Less movement in the library, the dialogs and the icons.

motions.systemTip: As much as the computer's own setting allows
motions.reducedTip: Things appear and change without moving

general.sidebarNote: Icons only folds it to a narrow strip. {{keys}} switches between them.
general.yourSkinsNote: Everything you add stays here between launches. Copy this folder to back it up.

ai.title: Where pictures are made
ai.find: key keys api provider providers model
ai.note: FolderSkin has no server. With a key, Generate with AI sends your request straight from your machine to the provider, billed to your account. The Local Model makes them for free, once it's set up.

sharing.title: Licence profiles
sharing.note: A pack you share says who made it and how others may use it. Keep a profile for each way you share: sharing starts from the default one.

problems.author: Credit goes to a name made of letters, numbers and single dashes.
problems.full_one: There can be {{count}} profile at most. Delete one to add this one.
problems.full_other: There can be {{count}} profiles at most. Delete one to add this one.

about.intro: Your best memories wear the same plain folder as your old paperwork. FolderSkin gives every folder a look that fits what's inside: a golden-hour film still for summer photos, a vintage travel poster for a trip, pop art for a video project, soft pastels for a birthday.

points.skins: Skins from free community packs, from your own photos, or designed by you.
points.ai: Describe a style and AI paints it, with your own key or free with the Local Model.

fileBrowser.macos: Skins show up right in Finder, and any folder gets its own icon back in one click.
fileBrowser.windows: Skins show up right in Explorer, and any folder gets its own icon back in one click.
fileBrowser.linux: Skins show up right in Files, and any folder gets its own icon back in one click.

points.free: Free and open source. No account, no tracking.

about.newerNote: They come from FolderSkin's releases on GitHub, and install when you say so.
